# Auto-generated CMakeLists.txt for republisher nodes
# Converted to ROS2 ament_cmake format
# Do not edit manually - this file is generated by ros2repub-gen.sh

# Get parent build directory (since we're in a subdirectory)
get_filename_component(PARENT_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} DIRECTORY)

# List of all republisher executables
set(CONVERT_NODES
    lcm_convert_ros2bag
    csv_convert_ros2bag
)

find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)

# Create executables for each republisher
foreach(NODE_NAME ${CONVERT_NODES})
    add_executable(${NODE_NAME} ${NODE_NAME}.cpp)
    
    # Add ROS2 dependencies
    ament_target_dependencies(${NODE_NAME}
        rclcpp
        std_msgs
        rosbag2_cpp
        sensor_msgs
        geometry_msgs
    )
    
    # Link LCM library
    target_link_libraries(${NODE_NAME}
        ${LCM_LIBRARIES}
    )
    
    # Include directories for LCM headers and source
    target_include_directories(${NODE_NAME} PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..
        ${LCM_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    )
    
    # Ensure messages are generated and symlinks are created before building executables
    # Note: In subdirectory context, we need to use parent directory's target name
    # The message generation happens in parent CMakeLists.txt, so we rely on
    # rosidl_get_typesupport_target which already handles this dependency
    if(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME}_create_symlinks)
        add_dependencies(${NODE_NAME} ${PROJECT_NAME}_create_symlinks)
    endif()
    
    # Link to generated message types (using new ROS2 API)
    # This automatically adds include paths for generated message headers
    rosidl_get_typesupport_target(cpp_typesupport_target ${PROJECT_NAME} "rosidl_typesupport_cpp")
    target_link_libraries(${NODE_NAME} "${cpp_typesupport_target}")
    
    # Explicitly add include directory for generated message headers
    # Generated headers are in: build/lcm_to_ros2/rosidl_generator_cpp/lcm_to_ros2/msg/
    # So the include directory should be: build/lcm_to_ros2/rosidl_generator_cpp
    target_include_directories(${NODE_NAME} PUBLIC
        ${PARENT_BINARY_DIR}/rosidl_generator_cpp
    )
    
    # Install executable
    install(TARGETS ${NODE_NAME}
        DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME}
    )
endforeach()
